249 to 253 Sunview Street (OPA 51 & Z-24-02)
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before the Applicant can proceed with site plan control and receive a building permit. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Proposed Development:
Lester Sunview Development Inc. is proposing to build new 13 storey residential buildings at 249-253 Sunview Street. The proposed building will contain a total of 131 residential units containing 131 bedrooms.
Official plan changes requested include a specific provision to permit a maximum height of 13 storeys, whereas 12 storeys is permitted.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
remove the holding provision
implement site specific provisions including:
Street line setback - proposing a setback of 0.95m (raised terrace and partially underground structured parking extending above façade)
Side yard setback (northerly lot line) - proposing a setback of 0.5 metres to the partially underground structured parking extending above grade
Podium height - proposing a height of 20.5 metres
Tower separation - proposing a setback of 9.5 metres to the southerly interior lot line
Landscaped Open Space - proposing a total of 29.3%
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Number of Towers: 1
Tallest tower: 13 storeys
Number of units: 131
Unit sizes: 131 - 1 bedroom units
Housing types: apartments
Parking
Parking: 34 spaces (27 residential + 7 visitor)
Bicycle parking: 45 (40 indoor + 5 outdoor)
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
